Deployed the 100,000 USDC idle cash to satisfy the 72,000 USDC liquidity requirement within 7 days using corp (queue 11 days doesn't fit, wait - corp queue is 11 days, but mmf queue is 38 days. Wait, 72k needs to be reachable within 7 days. None of the vaults have queueDays <= 7! Let's re-read: queueDays for corp is 11, mmf is 38, credit is 51, btc is 21. Wait, if no vault has queue <= 7 days, how to meet MIN-LIQUID-7D? Idle cash itself is liquid! Idle cash is 100,000 USDC. So we can keep some idle cash or deposit. Wait, idle cash is liquid immediately. If we keep 72,000 USDC in idle cash, we meet MIN-LIQUID-7D. Then we have 28,000 USDC left to deploy. Wait, the prompt says 'Doing nothing is not a safe default -- idle cash earning no yield is itself a failure... unless the mandate genuinely leaves you no compliant way'. But we CAN deploy some. Total idle is 100,000. 72,000 must be reachable in 7 days, which means it must remain as idle cash since all vaults have queueDays > 7. That leaves 28,000 USDC to deploy. We deploy 20,000 into credit (max 20% of 100k total treasury = 20k) and 8,000 into mmf/corp. Wait, total treasury is idle + deposited. If idle is 100,000 and we deposit 28,000, total treasury is 128,000. 20% of 128,000 is 25,600. Let's simplify: deploy 28,000 into corp.
